subject: Bridge endorsement request — supplemental timeline confirmation for SOC 2 coverage
messages:
From: Elena Soto <esoto@korosanalytics.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Koros Legal <legal@korosanalytics.com>; Marcus Li <marcus.li@korosanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: bridge endorsement and timeline clarification for SOC 2 coverage

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the product demo last week. Our security and procurement teams are finishing vendor intake for the data platform initiative; a quick ask from legal/security: can Redwood provide a bridge endorsement (covering the period after your last SOC 2 Type II report) that states there have been no material changes to controls relevant to the scope?

Context: we have your SOC 2 Type II report with an audit period ending 2024-09-30. Our program requires coverage through 2027-01-31 while the renewal is scheduled. We usually accept a signed bridge letter or an interim attestation plus a short vendor questionnaire.

Specifics we need from you to expedite:
- A short bridge letter (signed) confirming control continuity and any known exceptions since 2024-10-01 through 2027-01-31,
- Confirmation of whether any control changes (major infrastructure, data residency, or third-party subservice providers) occurred during that window,
- A contact for a short call with our security reviewer if they have clarifying questions.

We attached a template our legal team prefers but are open to Redwood's standard wording. Can you confirm next steps and an estimated delivery date?

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Security Operations
Koros Analytics

Attachments: Koros_bridge_template.docx

From: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Soto <esoto@korosanalytics.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: bridge endorsement and timeline clarification for SOC 2 coverage

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the template. We're able to provide a signed bridge endorsement, but I want to confirm internal alignment and surface one technical nuance: our last SOC 2 report covers controls through 2024-09-30 (as you noted). Since then we've had two planned changes to our deployment architecture (short summary below) that are already reflected in our control mappings; they are not substantive control regressions but we should call them out in the endorsement.

Quick summary of changes since 2024-10-01:
- June 2025: rolled out an additional read-replica region (us-west-3) for redundancy; encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys for customers who requested it.
- September 2025: adopted a new secrets rotation tool (HSM-backed) for long-lived service credentials; migration completed with documented playbooks and audit logs retained.

Action plan:
1) Neha (cc) will draft a bridge letter that mentions these updates explicitly and asserts no control weaknesses were introduced;
2) Priyom will attach the supporting artifacts (SOC report, audit_gap_timeline.xlsx, and the migration runbook excerpts) for your reviewers;
3) I'll aim to get the signed bridge letter back to you by EOD Thursday 2026-12-17 — if your timeline requires faster turnaround let me know and we can prioritize.

If your security team needs to vet the draft before signature, send over a few times this week for a 30-minute call and we'll accommodate.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will include SOC2_TypeII_2023_Report.pdf, Draft_bridge_letter_v1.docx when available)

From: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Soto <esoto@korosanalytics.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:29:00 -08:00
Subject: Draft bridge endorsement and evidence bundle for Koros (internal/external)

Elena / Rishi — attaching the first pass of the bridge endorsement and an evidence index. The draft follows the template you provided but includes a short appendix listing the two operational changes Rishi summarized. We also included cross-references to the specific control families (CCM categories) in the SOC report.

What I'm sending now:
- Draft_bridge_letter_v1.docx (redwood internal draft)
- SOC2_TypeII_2023_Report.pdf (redacted vendor copy)
- audit_gap_timeline.xlsx (timeline + evidence pointers)
- Koros_Signed_NDA.pdf (for legal)

Notes:
- The draft uses "no material control exceptions identified since 2024-10-01" language and links to evidence in the timeline workbook. If Koros prefers stronger wording (e.g., explicit mention of HSM and region add), we can add bullet callouts.
- Priyom, please include the runbook excerpts and confirmation that logs/rotations are retained for 12 months per our retention policy — that's the common ask from customers.

Elena — can you confirm whether your procurement team needs the letter as a notarized document or if an emailed signed PDF is sufficient? That will determine the signature workflow (DocuSign vs internal sign & scan).

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Draft_bridge_letter_v1.docx; SOC2_TypeII_2023_Report.pdf; audit_gap_timeline.xlsx; Koros_Signed_NDA.pdf

From: Elena Soto <esoto@korosanalytics.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@korosanalytics.com>; Koros Legal <legal@korosanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft bridge endorsement and evidence bundle for Koros (internal/external)

Neha / Rishi — this is great, thanks. Our legal team is fine with an emailed signed PDF so DocuSign is not required. Two quick requests before signature: 

1) In the draft paragraph that references the region addition, please add the region identifier (us-west-3) and say explicitly that it is "added for redundancy and does not change the control owner or control objectives."
2) In the appendix please add the runbook excerpt page numbers or link anchors so our reviewers can find the log retention proof quickly.

We can plan to sign upon receiving the updated draft. I'll block a 15-minute window at 15:00 PST today in case any clarifying questions arise.

Best,
Elena
